text:
zoe_marketing: quick flag  inbound HubSpot -> enrichment -> RR claim -> Salesforce path is seeing assignment delays (~5-8m). SDRs pinging. :grimacing:

mike_ops: saw a spike at 11:35 PST, RR shards got busy and enrichment p99 jumped. claims were blocked waiting on enrichment.

tom_salesops: SLA we promised: ack <30s, assigned <2m, SF record <5m. current >5m is ~9% this morning. we need a fast mitigation.

nina_eng: short-term plan: enable TTL-based fallback to send a minimal payload to SF after 60s and tag records with `handoff_minimal=true`. also temporarily increase enrichment workers during peak.

zoe_marketing: please gate to peak window and tag so SDRs can filter. want to minimize noise in SF.

mike_ops: agree. propose 25m canary from 11:40-12:05, fallback_tag = `ttl60_canary_v2`. i'll add a dashboard tile for `handoff_minimal=true`.

nina_eng: config i'll flip (will keep minimal):
```yaml
enrichment:
  workers: 28
  timeout_seconds: 60
  fallback_to_sf_minimal: true
  fallback_tag: "ttl60_canary_v2"
rr_claim:
  fairness_window_ms: 4000
```

handoff-bot: deploy started by mike_ops at 5101010150 :rocket:

nina_eng: deployed and enabled fallback. monitoring now.

zoe_marketing: early signal: >5m assigns fell from 9% -> 2% in first 4m. i'll send a short note to SDR channel: "Temporary minimal handoff enabled for peak; some records may include handoff_minimal=true."

tom_salesops: good. next: nina to open RFC for RR fairness + graceful degrade; mike to create alert `enrichment.queue > 400 for 5m`; zoe to own SDR comms.

mike_ops: alert created. will page if persistent.

zoe_marketing: thanks all  follow-up in our ops sync."
